abilities.descEn: One of that Ranger's skills will activate when they are defeated.
abilities.descZh: Ranger被打倒時將發動一項自己的技能。

abilities.descEn: Frequently avoids the effects of Ice Shot and Blizzard items.
abilities.descZh: 該Ranger能夠以高機率閃避「發射冰／暴風雪」的道具效果。

abilities.descEn: Some of the Mineral used to produce that Ranger is restored when they are defeated.
abilities.descZh: Ranger被打倒時可回收一部份生產該Ranger時所消耗的礦物。
